sectionHeading.description: Novyra is a new studio. We will not invent client stories, inflated numbers, or results we cannot prove. Instead, every engagement follows a visible delivery standard.

featuredCommitment.title: You'll Never Wonder What's Happening
featuredCommitment.description: Most agencies go quiet between kickoff and delivery. We don't. Every project runs on a rhythm you can see into from day one — no status emails standing in for a real answer.
bullets: Weekly demo calls on working software, not slide decks
A shared task board you can check anytime, day or night
Direct chat access to the engineers building it — not a rotating account manager
Every commit visible in a shared repository from the first day

direct-communication.title: Direct Communication
direct-communication.description: Talk to the engineers actually building your product — not a relay through an account manager.

fixed-pricing.title: Fixed & Transparent Pricing
fixed-pricing.description: A fixed quote before work starts, and no surprise invoices once it's underway.

weekly-demos.title: Weekly Progress Demos
weekly-demos.description: See real, working progress every week — never a status email standing in for a demo.

code-ownership.title: Full Source Code Ownership
code-ownership.description: Every line of code is yours, handed over in full — no vendor lock-in.

post-launch-support.title: Post-Launch Support Window
post-launch-support.description: A defined support period after launch to fix issues and tune performance.

auditable-stack.title: Modern, Auditable Stack
auditable-stack.description: Every technology choice is documented and explainable — no inherited legacy black boxes.

cta.heading: Be Among Our First Partners
cta.description: Being new means founding clients get the whole team's attention, not a fraction of it — no account layers, no legacy baggage, just focused execution.
